summary.en: Asian markets show mixed signals ahead of U.S. open, with focus on tech earnings and Fed commentary. Oil prices stable near key support levels despite geopolitical tension. DXY consolidation in narrow range as traders await CPI print. Treasury yields holding steady; 10Y yield near 4.1% amid inflation data expectations.
summary.zh: 亚洲市场开盘前呈现分化格局，市场聚焦科技股财报与美联储官员言论。油价在关键支撑位附近企稳，尽管地缘政治紧张持续。美元指数窄幅震荡等待 CPI 数据公布；美债收益率稳定在 4.1% 左右。

impact.en: Major tech stocks preview earnings ahead of Q3, driving premarket volatility. AI infrastructure spending remains strong theme.
impact.zh: 主要科技股在第三季度之前预览财报，推动盘前波动。AI 基础设施支出保持强劲主题。

macroRisk.en: Fed policy uncertainty weighs on tech valuations.
macroRisk.zh: 美联储政策不确定性压制科技股估值。

title.zh: 地缘政治中的油价稳定

impact.en: WTI crude consolidating near $73/bbl despite Middle East tensions. Energy sector rotation continues.
impact.zh: 尽管中东紧张局势，WTI 原油在 73 美元/桶附近整合。能源板块轮换继续。

macroRisk.en: Inflation rebound risks via energy transmission to CPI core print.
macroRisk.zh: 能源向 CPI 核心数据传播引发通胀反弹风险。

impact.en: 10Y yield steady near 4.1%, implying stable growth-inflation expectations. Bond market pricing in higher for longer narrative.
impact.zh: 10 年期收益率稳定在 4.1% 附近，暗示稳定的增长通胀预期。债券市场对更高利率更长叙事进行定价。

macroRisk.en: Yield curve inversion persists; recession signals ignored by policy makers.
macroRisk.zh: 收益率曲线倒挂持续；政策制定者忽视衰退信号。

impact.en: Retail sales data shows softness. Discount retailers report better margins than big-box competitors.
impact.zh: 零售销售数据表现疲软。折扣零售商报告的利润率高于大型竞争对手。

macroRisk.en: Recession fears mounting if employment data deteriorates further.
macroRisk.zh: 如果就业数据进一步恶化，衰退担忧加剧。

impact.en: Electric vehicle makers face pricing pressure amid supply chain normalization. Tesla earnings catalyst next week.
impact.zh: 电动汽车制造商面临定价压力，供应链正常化。特斯拉下周财报催化剂。

bullish: Battery costs declining faster than expected

macroRisk.en: Interest rate sensitivity for capital-intensive manufacturers.
macroRisk.zh: 资本密集型制造商对利率敏感。

ai.en: AI chip demand remains strong despite macro headwinds. Nvidia earnings preview dominates sentiment with guidance expected robust. Cloud providers accelerate capacity buildout ahead of holiday season.
ai.zh: AI 芯片需求保持强劲，尽管宏观环境承压。英伟达财报预览主导情绪，预期指引稳健。云服务商加速扩大容量以备假日旺季。

semiconductor.en: Memory chip prices recovering slowly; storage demand from data centers improving. Logic segment benefiting from AI workloads but consumer electronics softer.
semiconductor.zh: 存储芯片价格缓慢复苏；数据中心存储需求改善。逻辑段受益于 AI 工作负载，但消费电子疲软。

bigTech.en: Magnificent seven earnings season begins; advertising revenue under pressure but cloud services strong. Social media metrics mixed with user engagement declining slightly.
bigTech.zh: 七巨头财报季开启；广告收入承压但云服务强劲。社交媒体指标混合，用户参与度略微下降。

energy.en: Oil prices stable; natural gas prices elevated due to weather concerns. Renewable energy stocks underperform as grid constraints limit growth.
energy.zh: 油价稳定；天然气价格因天气担忧而居高不下。可再生能源股票跑输大盘，电网限制阻碍增长。

ev.en: EV market consolidation continues; pricing pressure intensifies as charging infrastructure lags adoption. Chinese competitors gain share globally but face U.S. tariff barriers.
ev.zh: 电动车市场整合持续；随着充电基础设施滞后于采用，定价压力加剧。中国竞争对手在全球获得份额但面临美国关税壁垒。

market.en: S&P futures mixed; tech weighting supports overall direction despite broader economic uncertainty. NASDAQ leads gains on AI enthusiasm but consumer stocks lag.
market.zh: 标普期货分化；科技权重支持整体方向，尽管宏观经济存在不确定性。纳斯达克因 AI 热情领先收益但消费股滞后。

preciousMetals.en: Gold consolidates near all-time highs; safe-haven demand intact but inflation hedge less compelling with stable price environment.
preciousMetals.zh: 金价在历史高位附近盘整；避险需求 intact 但通胀对冲在稳定价格环境下吸引力减弱。

oil.en: WTI stable near $73/bbl; global inventory builds offsetting supply disruptions. OPEC+ production discipline remains firm but spare capacity building.
oil.zh: WTI 在 73 美元/桶附近稳定；全球库存增长抵消供应中断。OPEC+ 生产纪律保持坚定，但 spare capacity 正在增长。

futures.en: S&P futures mixed (-0.1% to +0.3%); tech leading direction despite macro uncertainty. NASDAQ elevated on AI optimism but consumer sectors lag.
futures.zh: 标普期货分化 (-0.1% 至 +0.3%)；科技股尽管宏观不确定性主导方向。纳斯达克因 AI 乐观情绪领先但消费板块滞后。

treasury10Y.en: Yield steady near 4.1%, pricing in higher for longer Fed narrative. Bond market pricing cautious about recession signals despite yield curve inversion persistence.
treasury10Y.zh: 收益率稳定在 4.1% 附近，定价更高利率更长美联储叙事。债券市场对衰退信号定价谨慎，尽管收益率曲线倒挂持续。

dxy.en: Consolidating in range; European central bank divergence providing some support. Risk sentiment mixed with emerging markets showing weakness amid dollar strength.
dxy.zh: 在范围内整合；欧洲央行分歧提供一些支持。风险情绪混合，新兴市场在美元强势下表现疲软。

oil.en: WTI stable near $73/bbl; Brent near $79. Global demand concerns from China economic slowdown offset by geopolitical risk premium.
oil.zh: WTI 稳定在 73 美元/桶附近；布油在 79 美元附近。全球需求担忧来自中国经济放缓，被地缘政治风险溢价抵消。

keyRisk.en: Inflation data release may trigger Fed policy reassessment; employment data showing unexpected weakness could shift expectations toward earlier rate cuts.
keyRisk.zh: 通胀数据发布可能触发美联储政策重新评估；就业数据意外疲软可能将预期转向更早降息。

note.en: Market showing mixed signals ahead of major economic data print. Tech earnings optimism offset by consumer weakness and geopolitical risks. Bond market pricing in cautious stance with yield curve inversion concerns persisting.
note.zh: 主要经济数据发布前市场呈现混合信号。科技股财报乐观情绪被消费疲软和地缘政治风险抵消。债券市场定价谨慎立场，收益率曲线倒挂担忧持续。
